title: Materialize Git LFS bytes
responsibility: Recognize Git LFS pointers and download content only from permitted HTTPS locations with matching size and hash.

inputs.name: githubLfs.options
inputs.description: Repository identity, scoped read-token callback and optional fetch implementation.

inputs.name: githubLfs.bytes
inputs.description: Raw blob bytes; ordinary blobs pass through, while recognized LFS pointers must use the exact supported v1 format.

outputs.name: githubLfs
outputs.description: Original bytes for ordinary blobs, or downloaded bytes matching the pointer’s SHA-256 and declared size of at most 50,000,000 bytes.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Malformed pointers and oversized declarations fail directly; download, location, response and integrity failures become lfs-unavailable.
